paite: Adiktatna uh vakna bang a suah a, amah hotdamna khawnvak kuang bang a asuah masiah, Zion ziak in ka dai nilouh kei ding a, Jerusalem ziak in ka om kinken kei ding hi.
heading: TOUPA'N Zion A-it
english: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a lamp that burns.

paite: Huchi in na diktatna amu ding ua, kumpipa tengteng in na thupina amu ding uh; huan, min thak, TOUPA kam in asak ding in, ahon sam ding uh.
english: The nations shall see your righteousness, and all kings your glory, and you shall be called by a new name, which the mouth of Yahweh shall name.

paite: TOUPA khut a kilawmna lallukhu leh i Pathian khut a thupina lukhu na hi ding.
english: You shall also be a crown of beauty in the hand of Yahweh, and a royal diadem in the hand of your God.

paite: Taihsansa, ahon chi nawn kei ding uh; na gam leng, Loihsansa achi nawn sam kei ding uh; Hephzibah, ahon chita ding ua, na gam leng Beulah, achi ding uhi; TOUPA na tung ah akipak ngal a, na gam in pasal anei ding hi.
english: You shall no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall your land any more be termed Desolate: but you shall be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for Yahweh delights in you, and your land shall be married.

paite: Tangval in nungak zi a aneih bang in na tapate'n zi in ahon nei ding uh; mou neimi mou tung a akipah bang in, na tung ah na Pathian akipak ding hi.
english: For as a young man marries a virgin, so your sons shall marry you; and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

paite: Jerusalem aw, na kulh tung ah galvilmi ka vilsak a; sun leh zan in chik lai mah in adai kei ding; nou TOUPA theihpih ding a omte aw, om kinken het kei un.
english: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem; they shall never hold their peace day nor night: you who call on Yahweh, take no rest,

paite: Amah leng om kinkensak kei un, Jerusalem ahihkip a, lei a phathuai a abawl masiah.
english: and give him no rest, until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

paite: TOUPA'N akhut taklam leh abanhat lou a akichiam in, na buh nang hon dou mite an ding in ka pe nawn kei ding a; gamdang mite'n nna sepkhiak uain adawn nawn kei ding uh.
english: Yahweh has sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, “Surely I will no more give your grain to be food for your enemies; and foreigners shall not drink your new wine, for which you have labored:

paite: Abuh late'n ane zaw ding ua, TOUPA aphat ding ua alou mite'n ka Mun Siangthou huangsung intual ah adawnta ding, chi in.
english: but those who have garnered it shall eat it, and praise Yahweh; and those who have gathered it shall drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”

paite: Pawt unla, kulh kongpite ah pawt un; mite a ding in lampi bawl unla; sungvum un, lamlian sungvum un; suangte tomsiang unla; mite a ding in chiamtehna takkhia un.
english: Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way of the people! Cast up, cast up the highway! Gather out the stones! Lift up a banner for the peoples.

paite: Ngai un, kawlmong pha in huchi in atheisak ahi, Zion tanu kiang ah hichi in gen un, "En in, nangmah hotdamna ahong tung ding; en in, akipahman akiang ah a-om hi, aditna leng ama ah a-om hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh has proclaimed to the end of the earth, “Say to the daughter of Zion, ‘Behold, your salvation comes. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.’”

paite: Huchi in amau, 'Mipi Siangthou, TOUPA tatte,' achi ding uh; nang bel Zonkhiak, Paisan louh khopi ahon chi ding uh, chi in,” achi hi.
english: They shall call them The holy people, The redeemed of Yahweh: and you shall be called Sought out, A city not forsaken.
